subject: C2 question: move the Petri auditor off Modal?
body: Nathan asks (your call as C2 owner). Each Modal workspace that runs H100s needs its own card on file, so pooling team Modal credits means every teammate adds a card. The auditor (Qwen3-235B, 4xH100 per audit) is most of the Modal bill: pilot roughly $16-32, full E3b roughly $130-250 (estimates). Options: (a) keep it on Modal, Nathan's workspace nqiu07 only, plus Modal support moving credits if they allow it; (b) run the auditor on Tinker (pooled credits, no cards; Qwen3-235B is deprecated there, so a different model); (c) run it on OpenAI with Nathan's key. With (b) or (c), Modal only serves the held-out Qwen target and the gpt-oss judge. Changing the auditor changes audit behavior, so decide before the pilot: baseline and final runs need the same auditor. Nathan is running the pilot baseline on the current Modal auditor in the meantime, if nqiu07 billing allows.
